facts: auth_clients.id is the UUIDv7 internal management key. auth_clients.client_id is independently unique PostgreSQL text with character length 1..100.
Identity ClientRow.json returns id and clientId from those separate columns. OAuth client lookup uses the public client_id; internal management lookup uses id.
Current create defaults the public text to id.to_string(), but this is a creation choice, not a projection invariant. Both equal and distinct IDs are valid.

The standard Phase21 fixture intentionally registers p21-* public identifiers separate from internal UUID keys and has already exchanged real tokens. Rewriting the fixture to UUID would conceal the faulty consumer.
Frontend already uses record.id for management URLs and group membership operations, while record.clientId is displayed/copied for protocol use.
Platform record projection incorrectly requires clientId==id, rejecting the valid independent records and making the entire registry page unavailable.

minimalFix.projectionRule: clientId must be a nonempty string with <=100 Unicode characters and no Unicode control characters, matching current schema/protocol. Do not add ASCII-only, trim-equality, UUID or inequality assumptions.
mustRemainStrict: GET/PATCH record.id remains bound to the internal path UUID
credential/group response clientId remains the internal UUID under those distinct operation contracts
other exact response fields, secret exclusion, application/source/fine-permission checks unchanged

regressionRequests: Distinct p21-* public ID in list and detail
Unicode and leading/trailing-space public IDs preserved without normalization
Reject non-string, empty, 101-character and Unicode-control public IDs
Reject invalid internal UUID and incorrect detail path binding
Bounded list still rejects secret/unknown fields
validationBoundary: Read-only contract/source audit. Production fix, its new PG/unit results and complete apps-r4 rebuild are separate evidence; none is claimed here.
